notes_for_editor: Thin record: one 1915 newspaper line and one index row. The story runs under the 120-word floor on purpose; it adds no padding. Nothing in the sources describes the structure, its builder, its staff or its site today. The brief's 'gone' status is not supported by the sources; the index says Abandoned. Coordinates are as the index gives them and are not verified.
